Title: What's at stake for Paramount, the Ellisons in Warner Bros. takeover bid
description: Paramount Skydance (PSKY) is facing some pushback from a collection of US attorneys general in its proposed acquisition of rival Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD). Evan Shapiro — better known as "The Media Cartographer" — comes on Market Domination Overtime to outline what is it at stake for the media giant and the Ellison family if the deal ultimately falls through.

Title: Netflix Rises 3% on a $95 Wolfe Research Price Target, Leaving Disney and Warner Bros. Discovery Behind
description: Wolfe Research says Netflix's rough summer had nothing to do with demand, and that one reframing sent shares jumping while Disney and Warner Bros. Discovery barely flinched. Here is what the analyst actually found buried in millions of viewing data points.

Title: The Retail Silence That Reshapes The Amazon Stock Bull Case
description: Management's narrative has pivoted hard from optimizing its massive retail machine to funding aggressive AI infrastructure buildouts, quietly changing what an investment in the company is actually a bet on.

Title: The Price of Progress for Google Stock
description: If you hold Alphabet (GOOGL) stock, the recent top-line numbers look spectacular. In the second quarter of 2026, the company delivered 24% overall revenue growth, propelled by an 82% surge in its Google Cloud segment. This is the AI-fueled future investors have been waiting for. But beneath the surface of that growth, a fundamental shift is underway in the company’s financial DNA, and it represents the most significant risk to the stock today.

Title: Netflix Stock Is Down Big-Time. Is This Finally a Buying Opportunity?
description: Has the market finally become too pessimistic about Netflix, or has the sell-off created a place to jump in?

Title: Netflix engagement data points to stronger results ahead, Wolfe says
description: Investing.com -- Wolfe Research has lifted its price target on Netflix (NASDAQ: NFLX) to $95 from $84, telling clients in a note that its analysis of viewing data suggests the streamer's soft second quarter was a scheduling issue rather than a demand problem.

Title: Get Paid 12% A Year To Hold NFLX Stock You Already Own
description: For Netflix shareholders, here is a way to get paid a meaningful income right now, money you keep no matter what, in exchange for agreeing to sell your stock at a higher price if it climbs.

Title: Netflix May Be Ready to Do Something It Long Resisted
description: The streamer is discussing bringing rival services onto its platform.

Title: YouTube Could Spark a Creator Bidding War That Hurts Netflix Stock
description: Netflix could face higher programming costs as YouTube spends to keep creators exclusive, putting pressure on the streaming company’s margins.

Title: Is Netflix (NFLX) Trading At A Discount Despite Strong Cash Flow?

That combination of solid long term returns and models suggesting the shares may still trade below intrinsic value is drawing fresh investor attention.
